note: The root key uses the place name’s own consonants.
summary: Sidon is a city on the Canaanite boundary. Genesis traces the boundary from Sidon toward Gerar as far as Gaza.

senses.definition: The city named as the starting point of the Canaanite boundary.

evidence.note: The boundary begins מִצִּידֹן, “from Sidon,” and proceeds toward Gerar.
